includes: Boat with full tank of gas
Stereo with aux cord on all boats
Temporary day boating license via contract
blurb: Guests rent boats to explore Okanagan Lake for activities like tubing, skiing, wakeboarding, or relaxing. Boats come with powerful engines and modern amenities. No boating license is required as a temporary day license is provided via contract.
extraNote: Damage deposit $1000 for Stealth Boat, $3000 for AXIS Wake Research boats · Fuel is extra; boat given with full tank, renter refills used fuel or cost deducted from deposit · No open alcohol allowed on boats; drinking is illegal and fined by bylaw · Credit card information or deposit required to hold reservation · Boat launch at 1354 Water Street, Kelowna. A crew member calls 5-10 minutes before reservation to assist.
